title: Terms of Service
intro: By using {appName}, you agree to these terms.

service.heading: The service
service.body: {appName} is a free worship companion for personal and educational use on iOS, Android, and web. It is provided by {author}. Features include Salah and Qaza tracking, Zikr, Qur'an and hadith libraries, learning content, prayer times, reminders, optional cloud sync, and related tools described on our <features>Features</features> page.

use.heading: Personal & educational use
use.body: You may use the app to support your own worship and share it with others for non-commercial personal or educational purposes. The source code may be used, modified, and redistributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License with required attribution to {appName} and a link to munibtracker.app. You may not resell it, sell customized versions, redistribute it as your own commercial product, scrape or bulk-redistribute bundled datasets in violation of their licenses, or use the service to harass others or break the law. {appName} does not currently accept sponsorship, funding, or donations — do not send money to anyone claiming to collect funds on its behalf.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: Guest mode requires no account. If you sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook, you are responsible for keeping access to that provider account secure. You must not impersonate others or attempt to access another user's synced data. We may suspend or terminate accounts that abuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or submit malicious content reports.

disclaimer.heading: Religious content disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Calculators and estimates (such as lifetime Qaza and missed-fast estimates), fiqh guides, and learning lessons are aids for education — not fatwas. For rulings specific to your situation, consult a qualified scholar. We strive for accuracy and cite open sources (see <credits>Credits</credits>), but the app is not a substitute for scholarly guidance. Scripture text and translations remain subject to their original licenses and attributions.
